response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, secure coding per IEC 62443, or cloud-based industrial platform design — core requirements for this role. Their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only a brief, isolated C++ stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, insufficient to meet senior C++ architectural demands.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse systems
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring
Proven ability to deliver scalable, event-driven systems and DevOps infrastructure
concerns: Minimal recent or relevant C++ experience; no evidence of STL, multi-threading, or high-performance C++ systems
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), MQTT, or industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, etc.)
Lacks demonstrated experience in on-premises industrial automation platforms or cloud-native industrial solutions
